name: 建筑模板-瞭望塔
name_ja: けんちくテンプレーウォッチタワー
data:
[core]
name: outpostT1Template
class: CustomUnitMetadata

#标签
tags: watchtower

displayText: Experimental Tank
displayDescription: -Very heavily armored\n-Armed with quad cannons\n-Can attack ground\n-Light air attack

displayText_zh: 瞭望塔
displayDescription_zh: -探查迷雾的示范瞭望塔模板

price: 1500
maxHp: 1500
mass: 9000

#footprint used for collisions with units (left, up, right, down)
footprint: -1,-1,1,1

#used for placement, and placement of other buildings
constructionFootprint: -1,-1,1,1

techLevel: 1
buildSpeed: 0.0005

radius: 20
isBuilding: true

fogOfWarSightRange: 34

#15 = default
#视野范围
fogOfWarSightRangeWhileNotBuilt: 15


[graphics]
image:        CORE:/outpost/outpost.png
#image_wreak:  outpost_dead.png

[attack]
canAttack: false
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits:   false
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false

#动态逻辑值示范
maxAttackRange: ${core.fogOfWarSightRange * 20 - 40}
showRangeUIGuide:true

[movement]
movementType: NONE
moveSpeed: 0
maxTurnSpeed: 0

[ai]
maxGlobal: 0
